repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.summary_zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一款基于 AI 大模型的智能短视频生成工具，支持一键生成高清横竖屏视频。用户只需输入主题或关键词，即可自动完成文案生成、素材匹配、语音合成、字幕添加及背景音乐配置，全面覆盖视频创作流程，支持多模型接入与批量处理，适用于内容创作者快速产出高质量短视频。
repos.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI-powered short video generation tool that leverages large language models to automatically create high-definition videos with one click. Users input a topic or keyword to generate scripts, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and background music. It supports multiple AI models, batch processing, and both vertical and horizontal formats, ideal for content creators seeking efficient video production.

repos.description: 1 min voice data can also be used to train a good TTS model! (few shot voice cloning)
repos.summary_zh: GPT-SoVITS 是一款强大的少样本语音克隆与文本转语音 WebUI 工具，支持零样本和少样本 TTS 训练，仅需 1 分钟语音数据即可微调模型，实现高保真跨语言语音合成，支持中英日韩等多种语言，集成语音分离、ASR 和文本标注等数据集构建工具。
repos.summary_en: GPT-SoVITS is a powerful few-shot voice cloning and text-to-speech WebUI that enables zero-shot and few-shot TTS training with just 1 minute of audio data. It supports cross-lingual synthesis in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and more, featuring integrated tools for voice separation, ASR, and dataset preparation.

repos.description: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源的前沿语音AI模型家族，涵盖长文本多说话人TTS与统一ASR。TTS支持90分钟4人对话合成，ASR支持50+语言、60分钟长音频单次转录，输出包含说话人、时间戳及内容的结构化文本，并支持vLLM加速与用户自定义上下文。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source frontier voice AI model family, featuring long-form multi-speaker TTS and unified ASR. TTS synthesizes 90-minute 4-speaker conversations, while ASR transcribes 60-minute audio in a single pass for 50+ languages, outputting structured text with speakers, timestamps, and content, supporting vLLM acceleration and custom context.

repos.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
repos.summary_zh: VoxCPM2 是 OpenBMB 推出的无分词器文本转语音系统，基于端到端扩散自回归架构直接生成连续语音表征，无需离散分词。2B 参数模型在超 200 万小时多语言语音数据上训练，支持 30 种语言、自然语言驱动的创意语音设计、可控语音克隆及 48kHz 录音室级音频输出，RTX 4090 上 RTF 低至 0.3，适合多语言 TTS、个性化语音定制与高质量语音克隆场景。
repos.summary_en: VoxCPM2 by OpenBMB is a tokenizer-free text-to-speech system that directly generates continuous speech representations via an end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture, bypassing discrete tokenization. The 2B-parameter model is trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data, supporting 30 languages, natural-language-driven creative voice design, controllable voice cloning, and 48kHz studio-quality audio output. With RTF as low as ~0.3 on RTX 4090, it is ideal for multilingual TTS, personalized voice customization, and high-fidelity voice cloning applications.

repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
repos.summary_en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
repos.summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
repos.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

repos.description: Buzz transcribes and translates audio offline on your personal computer. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper.
repos.summary_zh: Buzz是一款基于OpenAI Whisper的本地音频转录与翻译工具，支持离线运行。具备多硬件加速、实时麦克风转录、语音分离与说话人识别功能，可将音视频转为TXT/SRT/VTT字幕文件，适配Windows/macOS/Linux全平台。
repos.summary_en: Buzz is a local audio transcription and translation tool powered by OpenAI Whisper, running entirely offline. It features multi-hardware acceleration (CUDA/Apple Silicon/Vulkan), real-time microphone input, voice separation, and speaker identification, with export to TXT/SRT/VTT formats across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
repos.summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
repos.summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

repos.description: Netflix-level subtitle cutting, translation, alignment, and even dubbing - one-click fully automated AI video subtitle team | Netflix级字幕切割、翻译、对齐、甚至加上配音，一键全自动视频搬运AI字幕组
repos.summary_zh: VideoLingo 是一款全自动 AI 视频字幕处理工具，支持 YouTube 视频下载、WhisperX 精准字幕识别、NLP 驱动的智能分段、术语库构建、Netflix 级单行字幕翻译（三步翻译-反思-适配流程），以及 GPT-SoVITS/Azure/OpenAI 多平台配音，实现一键生成高质量多语言字幕与配音。
repos.summary_en: VideoLingo is an all-in-one AI-powered video translation and dubbing tool that automates YouTube video processing, WhisperX-based word-level subtitle recognition, AI-driven segmentation, custom terminology, Netflix-standard single-line translations via a 3-step Translate-Reflect-Adapt pipeline, and multi-platform dubbing using GPT-SoVITS, Azure, or OpenAI TTS, enabling one-click global video localization.

repos.description: High-Quality Voice Cloning TTS for 600+ Languages
repos.summary_zh: OmniVoice 是一款支持 600+ 语言的零样本语音克隆 TTS 模型，采用扩散语言模型架构，实现高质量语音生成与快速推理（RTF 低至 0.025）。支持语音克隆、音色设计、非语言符号控制及多语言发音修正，适用于跨语言语音合成、虚拟配音、多语言内容创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS model supporting 600+ languages with diffusion language model architecture. It delivers high-quality voice cloning, voice design, and fast inference (RTF 0.025), enabling multilingual speech synthesis for content creation, virtual dubbing, and voice AI applications.

repos.description: Spark-TTS Inference Code
repos.summary_zh: Spark-TTS 是基于 Qwen2.5 大语言模型的高效文本转语音系统，支持中英双语及零样本语音克隆，具备可控语音生成能力。其核心创新在于单流解耦语音标记与 LLM 直接预测音频编码，无需额外声学模型，显著提升推理效率并降低部署复杂度，适用于多语言场景下的语音合成与跨语言迁移。
repos.summary_en: Spark-TTS is an efficient LLM-based text-to-speech model using Qwen2.5 for high-quality, bilingual (Chinese/English) speech synthesis. It supports zero-shot voice cloning and controllable generation (e.g., gender, pitch) with a single-stream decoupled architecture that directly reconstructs audio from LLM-predicted tokens, eliminating the need for separate acoustic models and enabling cross-lingual applications.

repos.description: 用文本编辑器剪视频
repos.summary_zh: AutoCut 是一款基于 Whisper 字幕识别的视频剪辑工具，用户通过编辑 Markdown 文件选择保留片段，即可自动裁切视频。支持多种 Whisper 模型（含 large-v3-turbo 加速版）、faster-whisper 及 OpenAI API，兼容本地与 Docker 部署，无需专业视频软件即可完成精准剪辑。
repos.summary_en: AutoCut is a video editing tool that uses Whisper-based automatic subtitle generation. Users select clips by editing Markdown files, enabling precise video cutting without professional software. It supports multiple Whisper models (including large-v3-turbo for speed), faster-whisper, and OpenAI API, with local and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: 一个简单的本地网页界面，使用ChatTTS将文字合成为语音，同时支持对外提供API接口。A simple native web interface that uses ChatTTS to synthesize text into speech, along with support for external API interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: ChatTTS-ui 是一个本地网页界面，基于 ChatTTS 模型实现文字转语音功能，支持中英文及数字混合文本合成，并提供 API 接口供外部调用。支持 Windows 预打包版、Linux 容器及源码部署，兼容 CPU/GPU 加速（NVIDIA CUDA 或 AMD ROCm），首次运行自动下载模型文件。
repos.summary_en: ChatTTS-ui is a local web interface that uses the ChatTTS model to synthesize text into speech, supporting mixed Chinese-English text and numbers, with external API support. It offers pre-packaged Windows version, Linux container deployment, and source code setup, with CPU/GPU acceleration via NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm, and automatic model download on first run.

repos.description: FunASR-powered video transcription, subtitle generation, and LLM-assisted clipping tool with a local Gradio UI.
repos.summary_zh: FunClip 是一款开源、精准且易用的视频语音识别与剪辑工具，集成阿里巴巴通义语音实验室开源的 FunASR Paraformer 系列模型，支持中文及英文语音识别，具备热词定制、说话人分离、多段自由剪辑等功能，并引入 LLM 智能剪辑能力，用户可通过 Gradio 界面快速生成精准视频片段与字幕。
repos.summary_en: FunClip is an open-source, accurate, and user-friendly video speech recognition and clipping tool. It leverages Alibaba's FunASR Paraformer models for ASR, supports Chinese and English, enables hotword customization, speaker separation, multi-segment clipping, and integrates LLM-based AI clipping via Qwen/GPT series models with customizable prompts for intelligent video editing.

repos.description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

repos.description: 这是一个Android系统TTS应用，内置微软演示接口，可自定义HTTP请求，可导入其他本地TTS引擎，以及根据中文双引号的简单旁白/对话识别朗读 ，还有自动重试，备用配置，文本替换等更多功能。
repos.summary_zh: TTS Server 是一款专为 Android 设计的文本转语音应用，集成微软演示接口，支持自定义 HTTP 请求、本地 TTS 引擎导入及基于中文双引号的智能旁白识别朗读，具备自动重试、备用配置和文本替换等高级功能，适用于多场景语音合成需求。
repos.summary_en: TTS Server is an Android-based text-to-speech application featuring Microsoft demo interface integration, customizable HTTP requests, local TTS engine support, and smart narration recognition via Chinese quotation marks. It includes advanced features like auto-retry, fallback configurations, and text replacement for versatile speech synthesis.

repos.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与演示制作工具，作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代方案。支持窗口/全屏录制、自动缩放、光标特效、摄像头画中画、本地 AI 字幕生成及 AI 编辑助手，适用于产品演示、教程视频和社交媒体内容创作，支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 跨平台使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording and demo creation tool, positioned as an alternative to Screen Studio. It features window/full-screen recording, auto-zooms, cursor effects, webcam overlay, on-device AI captions, and an AI editing assistant. Ideal for product demos, tutorials, and social media content across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
repos.summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

repos.description: ✨ AsrTools: Smart Voice-to-Text Tool | Efficient Batch Processing | User-Friendly Interface | No GPU Required | Supports SRT/TXT Output | Turn your audio into accurate text in an instant!
repos.summary_zh: AsrTools 是一款智能语音转文字工具，支持批量音频/视频文件处理，提供 SRT/TXT/字幕文件输出，具备高颜值 PyQt5 界面与多线程并发能力，无需 GPU 即可快速生成准确文本，适用于字幕制作与语音内容提取。
repos.summary_en: AsrTools is an intelligent voice-to-text tool that supports batch processing of audio and video files, generating SRT/TXT/subtitle outputs with a user-friendly PyQt5 interface. It uses multi-threading for fast conversion, requires no GPU, and enables instant text extraction from media files.

repos.description: 开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案 | 集成FunASR本地模型和可配置大语言模型的下一代中文桌面语音工作流
repos.summary_zh: 蛐蛐 (QuQu) 是一款开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案，专为中文用户打造的桌面端智能语音工作流工具。集成阿里巴巴 FunASR 本地语音识别模型和可配置大语言模型，实现高精度中文识别与智能文本优化，支持隐私保护、国产 AI 模型适配及开发者友好功能，完全免费且跨平台。
repos.summary_en: QuQu is an open-source, free alternative to Wispr Flow, designed as a next-generation Chinese desktop voice workflow tool. It integrates Alibaba's FunASR local speech recognition model with configurable large language models, enabling high-precision Chinese transcription and intelligent text optimization. Features include privacy protection, support for domestic AI models, and developer-friendly formatting, all completely free and cross-platform.

repos.description: 🤖 叮当是一款可以工作在 Raspberry Pi 上的中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目。
repos.summary_zh: 叮当是一款专为树莓派设计的开源中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目，支持模块化插件扩展、微信远程操控、多平台语音识别与合成技术，并集成智能家居控制功能，旨在帮助中国开发者快速构建个性化智能设备。
repos.summary_en: Dingdang is an open-source Chinese voice dialogue robot/smart speaker project designed for Raspberry Pi, featuring modular plugins, WeChat integration, multi-platform STT/TTS support, and smart home control, enabling developers to easily build personalized voice assistants.

repos.description: MacOS语音输入法，实时识别、大模型文本优化、全本地存储
repos.summary_zh: Type4Me 是一款 macOS 语音输入工具，支持本地/云端双引擎识别、大模型文本优化及全本地存储。基于 SherpaOnnx 实现设备端离线语音识别，无需 API Key；集成火山引擎等云端服务，提供实时流式识别与多模态 Prompt 处理。支持自定义快捷键、热词管理、片段替换及 CSV 导出，兼顾隐私性与扩展性。
repos.summary_en: Type4Me is a macOS voice input tool featuring dual local/cloud ASR engines, LLM-powered text optimization, and full local storage. Powered by SherpaOnnx for offline on-device recognition without API keys, it integrates cloud services like Volcengine for real-time streaming and advanced prompt processing. Includes customizable hotkeys, vocabulary management, clipboard context support, and CSV export, balancing privacy with extensibility.

repos.description: 腾讯会议摸鱼工具
repos.summary_zh: TMSpeech 是一款 Windows 平台的实时语音转文字工具，基于 sherpa-onnx 框架实现中文会议语音识别，支持 WASAPI 内录、实时字幕显示与历史记录保存。具备低 CPU 占用（<5%）、无边框可拖动界面、自定义外部识别器集成等功能，适用于会议转录、走神备忘等场景。
repos.summary_en: TMSpeech is a Windows-based real-time speech-to-text tool using the sherpa-onnx framework for Chinese meeting transcription. It captures system audio via WASAPI, displays live subtitles like lyrics, and saves recognition history. Features include low CPU usage (<5%), draggable UI, and support for custom external recognizers, ideal for meetings and note-taking.

repos.description: 🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Voxt 是一款专为 macOS 设计的语音输入与翻译应用，支持全局热键录音、实时波形显示、多引擎语音识别（本地 MLX 和远程 ASR 服务）及文本增强翻译，具备剪贴板安全粘贴、历史记录管理和多模式触发机制，适用于跨语言实时转录与翻译场景。
repos.summary_en: Voxt is a macOS menu bar app for voice input and translation, featuring global hotkey recording, real-time waveform display, multi-engine speech recognition (local MLX and remote ASR), text enhancement, and clipboard-safe auto-paste. It supports transcription, translation, selected-text processing, and history management with configurable providers.

repos.description: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
repos.summary_zh: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: TTS-文本转语音/文本转语音前端，兼容OpenAI、EdgeTTS等接口
repos.summary_zh: LibreTTS 是一款开源在线文本转语音工具，支持300+种语言和口音的声音，兼容OpenAI与EdgeTTS等主流TTS接口。提供实时试听、语速语调调节、长文本分段处理、历史记录及自定义API配置功能，支持Vercel和Cloudflare Pages一键部署，适合个人或企业快速搭建私有化TTS服务。
repos.summary_en: LibreTTS is an open-source online text-to-speech tool supporting 300+ voices across multiple languages and accents. It integrates with OpenAI, EdgeTTS, and other compatible APIs, offering real-time preview, adjustable speech rate/pitch, long-text segmentation, history tracking, and custom API configuration. Deployable via Vercel or Cloudflare Pages for private TTS solutions.

repos.description: Core library for Cola. Provides essential capabilities commonly used by agents.
repos.summary_zh: coli 是 Cola 项目的核心库，为 AI 智能体提供语音识别（ASR）、文本转语音（TTS）及云端 TTS 等基础能力。支持本地模型与 ListenHub OpenAPI 集成，具备流式 ASR 和 macOS 专用 TTS 功能，适用于构建语音交互应用。
repos.summary_en: Coli is the core library for the Cola project, delivering essential capabilities like automatic speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), and cloud-based TTS via ListenHub OpenAPI for AI agents. It supports local models, streaming ASR, and macOS-exclusive TTS features, ideal for voice-enabled applications.
